result.raw_final:
Qatar Airways’ economy **checked baggage allowance depends on fare type and route**. On weight-based routes, it is typically **20 kg (Economy Lite), 25 kg (Classic), 30 kg (Convenience), or 35 kg (Comfort)**. Routes using the piece system have different limits; check your ticket or booking for the exact allowance. The airline’s site returned an access-denied page during this lookup, so I couldn’t verify the current route-specific details directly.

FINAL ANSWER: Economy checked baggage is typically 20–35 kg depending on fare type; the exact allowance also depends on route.
